summary: Phase 2-continued e2e test (backend + frontend). Backend 26/26 tests pass (100%) — Books CRUD, NOK pricing, audience filter, validate dry-run with all 7 expected warning codes, admin overview + only_with_warnings filter all working. Frontend: navigation reorder (5 primary links), 'The Guardian' rebrand, Bookstore grid, BookDetail with read/exit modes, Reach Out form, Library audience tabs all PASS. ONE blocker on the Admin page: the validate-dry-run UI and the synced-files list UI are NOT RENDERED in AdminContent.jsx — only the create-entry form and GitHub sync card are present. State hooks and handlers exist, but the JSX sections are missing.

ui_bugs.issue: Markdown VALIDATE dry-run UI section is not rendered. State (validateText, validateResult, validating) and handler (handleValidate) exist (lines 28-31, 95-105), but no JSX uses them. Required testids missing: admin-validate-form, admin-validate-input, admin-validate-run, admin-validate-result, admin-validate-warning-{code}.

Synced-files / content-health overview list is not rendered. State (adminEntries, adminLoading, adminFilter) and loader (loadAdminEntries) exist (lines 34-36, 107-119), useEffect calls loadAdminEntries on mount, but no JSX iterates rows. Required testids missing: admin-list, admin-list-row-{slug}, admin-list-filter-all, admin-list-filter-warnings.

issues: Console hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — caused by ve-dynamic instrumentation wrapper inside <option> in select children. Cosmetic React warning only, does not break functionality.

action_items: Add the Markdown Validate dry-run UI section to /app/frontend/src/pages/AdminContent.jsx — a form with textarea (admin-validate-input), submit button (admin-validate-run), and a result block (admin-validate-result) that maps validateResult.warnings to chips with testid pattern admin-validate-warning-{code}. The handler handleValidate and state validateText/validateResult are already wired, just no JSX consumes them.

Add the synced-files / content-health list UI to AdminContent.jsx — render adminEntries with row testid admin-list-row-{slug} inside a container admin-list, plus two filter buttons admin-list-filter-all and admin-list-filter-warnings that call loadAdminEntries(false|true). Each row should show title, source_path, surface, source, and warnings count per the request.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminContent.jsx imports validateMarkdown and fetchAdminEntries and sets up full state/handlers but never renders the UI — strong indication the JSX was forgotten in commit. File still under 350 lines so adding ~40 lines is safe; no need to split.

Books seed slugs are 'genesis-protocols-volume-i-book' and 'kids-quiet-stories-volume-i' — the request mentioned 'aurin-hub' as a slug but no such book exists in seed (the example was illustrative). Detail endpoint and BookDetail page work correctly with the actual slugs. Recommend updating any docs that reference 'aurin-hub' as a book slug.

Library audience filter: 'Grown-ups' returns same count (9) as 'All' because every existing library entry was migrated to grown-ups and Reflections audience is empty. This is correct given the migration but the filter looks visually inert until other audiences gain content. Consider showing a count badge per tab.
Reach Out: form correctly shows 'Received, in spirit.' confirmation client-side (no backend submission per design). data-testid reach-out-sent present and verified.

rca_of_the_issue: AdminContent.jsx received state hooks (validateText/validateResult/validating, adminEntries/adminLoading/adminFilter), API client imports (validateMarkdown, fetchAdminEntries), and handlers (handleValidate, loadAdminEntries) plus a useEffect that loads admin entries on mount — but the corresponding JSX render blocks were never committed. The page therefore still shows only the create-entry form and the GitHub sync aside (lines 150-310 of AdminContent.jsx). Reproduction: navigate to /admin/content, query [data-testid=admin-validate-form] → null. Mitigation: add two render blocks (validate dry-run form + synced-files overview list with filter buttons) inside the existing <section> grid, using the already-wired state/handlers.
